L01: (define-fun spec ((amount Int) (max_rate Int)) Bool (and (>= amount 0) (<= amount max_rate)))
L02: (define-fun spec ((n Int) (max_rate Int)) Bool (<= n max_rate))
L03: (define-fun spec ((limit Int) (used Int) (cost Int)) Bool (<= (+ used cost) limit))
L04: (define-fun spec ((requested Int) (available Int)) Bool (<= requested available))
L05: (define-fun spec ((k Int) (calls Int)) Bool (<= k calls))
L07: (define-fun spec ((weight Int) (limit Int)) Bool (>= weight limit))
L08: (define-fun spec ((n Int) (limit Int)) Bool (<= n limit))
L09: (define-fun spec ((existing Int) (amount Int) (limit Int)) Bool (<= existing limit))
L10: (define-fun spec ((n Int) (capacity Int)) Bool (<= n capacity))
